description: This file is the main activity implementation for an Android application, managing UI fragments, options menu, dialogs, and notifications within the app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity handling UI fragments, menu options, dialogs, and notifications.

classes.name: MainActivity.MyDialogFragment
classes.description: Inner class for displaying dialogs within MainActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, restores state, and sets up UI fragments.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, removing items based on device features.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, updating toggle labels and visibility.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including launching activities, toggling titles, themes, dialogs, and notifications.

methods.name: toggleVisibleTitles
methods.description: Animates the showing or hiding of the titles fragment with custom animation.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, especially to show dialogs from notification actions.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog fragment with provided text.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays both standard and custom notifications.

methods.name: getDialogPendingIntent
methods.description: Creates a PendingIntent that triggers a dialog when the notification is tapped.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current theme and visibility state of titles fragment.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of items in the titles fragment and updates content accordingly.
